description: Diagnose a Spark run: the dashboard verdict (title, summary, and the top places to look, ranked by potential savings, each with its lead finding), findings, an impact-ranked fix recommendation rollup, and the writeTargets, metrics and effectiveConf blocks of the CLI report. view "compact" (the default) lists one short row per finding and leaves out the clean-check and not-checked lists; view "full" returns every finding with its remediation text and evidence, and those lists. Every finding row has a key that stays the same for the same finding in a rerun of the job (compare_runs rows list the same keys), and an id for get_finding_evidence. With format "md" the content is Markdown and structuredContent holds a few headline fields. When the server was started with --thresholds, findings and clean checks from a tuned detector carry tunedThresholds, and their impact estimates are uncalibrated. The result names the Spark application (app) and the build that wrote it (generator). runId is a handle for the run this server process has cached. It differs per tool by design (compare_runs returns runIdA and runIdB, evaluate_budgets the runId of its first run) and per server process, so match runs by app.id and app.attemptId, not by runId.

maxFindings.description: List at most this many findings, most severe first. findingsOmitted counts the ones left out; each verdict step still carries its lead finding.

minBand.description: List only findings at this band or a more severe one.

view.description: compact (default): one short row per finding. full: the CLI report's rows, clean checks and not-checked checks.

name: diagnose_run
